title: Extract host transport tests into their existing module file
outcome: Separate host transport production code from its tests without changing module paths, wire behavior or test coverage.
acceptance: Move the existing cfg(test) host::tests body from src/host.rs into src/host/tests.rs, preserving test names, helpers, assertions, literals and host::tests paths; runtime code and public interfaces are unchanged.

Demonstrate a mechanical move with reviewed diff, preserved discovered host tests and passing affected host tests plus source-file-size guard; full gate and required independent review pair pass on the final frozen input.

completion.summary: Extracted all 27 host transport tests and helpers into src/host/tests.rs, preserving host::tests and production behavior; landed, pushed and installed the validated release.
